title: AQD Unified DOI Bundle (Volume Particle & Lattice Theory)
description: Unified deposit-ready bundle: merges multiple previously separated reproducibility/whitepaper packages into a single archive. Includes canonical constants lock (aqd_constants.json/tex), quantum annihilation (inflow/annihilation) package, jammed-lattice percolation + SOC + MST unit realisation bundle, proton module bundle, and the VP/AQD whitepaper (LOCK→derive→Gate rigor version). All image assets were removed on request. This revision adds a note on rate-dependent (dynamic) stiffness / jamming–unjamming (“eggshell” model) and prints rounded constants for readability while retaining machine-canonical values in JSON. This revision adds a minimal testable closure for the dynamic stiffness (“eggshell”) transition: an unjamming trigger condition (Psi_eff > Psi_y) and a 1st-order self-healing ODE for the jamming integrity variable g(t). This revision further adds a volume-integerization / packing-rectification coherence check for the core count N≈82 (125→82) and a tetrahedral-locking gate (4-point rigidity certificate) required to claim full c^2 stiffness of the 82-core. This revision also adds (i) a self-contained structural derivation of the Planck blackbody spectrum form from a rigid-shell barrier model, and (ii) a geometric closure producing 1/alpha ≈ 137.0364. A DOI completeness audit script (scripts/doi_audit.py) is included to enforce zero-missing internal DOI anchors.
